qualityGate.reason: The Playwright tests compile and use APIs correctly with awaited assertions, preserving test case IDs. However, selector quality is weak due to placeholder regex selectors ('category name'), generic selectors (h1), and assumptions without verification about the page content and product-category relationship. Assertions on page title and product relevance require stronger selectors or additional validation. There is no test data handling or reuse of selectors which impacts maintainability and reusability.
